title: Verify: Contribution history loading, empty, error and list unit tests
summary: Unit tests for history states with fetch mocked
description: Test history rendering for success, pending, empty and failure.
acceptance_criteria: Load error alert and submit still works
technical_constraints: fetch stubbed; history payload uses contributionFixture mirroring contributionJSON in backend/internal/contribution/handler.go

steps.action: Create file with jsdom env. Stub GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions?round_id=round-1 to return [contributionFixture]. Render with roundId 'round-1'; assert 'Loading suggestions…' initially, then within list 'Your suggestions' find contributionFixture.prompt and 'Sent'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionHistory.test.tsx -t "history renders"
steps.expected: Loading then history item with Sent

steps.action: Stub the GET to return []; assert 'No suggestions yet' appears.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionHistory.test.tsx -t "empty history"

steps.action: Stub the GET to return status 500 and POST to return 201 contributionFixture; assert alert 'Could not load your suggestions'; then type text, click Send and assert the POST was made and 'Idea sent' shows.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionHistory.test.tsx -t "history failure"
steps.expected: Error shown and submit still works
